_about: Chooms!'s story points (docs/design.md, C2 plan): each is a journal entry reaching a state. `path` is the entry's path in the game's journal, `kind` its kind (quest unless named), `when` 'done' (Succeeded) or 'started' (Active, Succeeded or Failed). A point V has passed lets each NPC use the knowledge cards for it (cards/, from C2's second half). The notes are ours, for whoever writes the cards; no game text. Paths seen in the user's saves on 2026-11-14 unless marked unverified. Lifepaths: the prologue quest V finished; only the Corpo one was seen.
